description: This file defines a custom exception class `DatatableEntryRequiredException` used within the Fineract project. The exception is thrown when data table resources are missing or certain conditions are not met related to data table entries.

classes.name: DatatableEntryRequiredException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending `AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException`, used to signal issues related to data table entries in the Fineract system.

methods.name: DatatableEntryRequiredException(String datatableName)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating a required data table entry is missing, with a message based on the data table name.

methods.name: DatatableEntryRequiredException(String datatableName, Long appTableId)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating an entry cannot be deleted because the data table is attached to an entity, including the application table ID.

calls: super(String messageCode, String defaultMessage, String... parameters)
